sourceSentences: [Mysteriaslol dUaznQF5iRc 03:42] if she can plant her Q onto this, she can even miss it and then by a recast, she can drag it through us
[Mysteriaslol dUaznQF5iRc 04:36] the moment her Q's down, 7 seconds cool down, it's very easy for us to now pressure and push her away in the lane
[Mysteriaslol dUaznQF5iRc 01:41] She's going to try to time her spells with your last hits or with your out techs cuz that's when you're standing still
[Mysteriaslol dUaznQF5iRc 06:18] Aurora's ult is an ability that actually slows and because of that reason it makes it very easy for her to then all in you

[Mysteriaslol dUaznQF5iRc 07:09] Her E is always the spell that she can use to then trade onto you and then escape afterwards because you can't really ever get close to her because you get slowed and she she dashes away.
[Mysteriaslol dUaznQF5iRc 00:58] her W, which good Aurora players will use in a very high value way that they use it to dodge a spell and then get close to you
